## 💡 Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see implemented.

## 📖 User Story

As a [user type], I want [feature] so that [benefit].

**Example:** As a Marketrix user, I want to export simulation results to CSV so that I can analyze the data in external tools.

## 💼 Business Value

- Competitive advantage
- Revenue impact
- Other (please specify):
